# netbox_secret_backend_role (Resource)

Manages a role on the NetBox secrets engine that mints tokens for a pre-existing NetBox service user.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Read-only tokens for an existing NetBox service user.
resource "netbox_secret_backend_role" "inventory_reader" {
  backend         = netbox_secret_backend.netbox.path
  name            = "inventory-reader"
  netbox_username = "svc-inventory"
  ttl             = 3600
  max_ttl         = 28800
}

# Write-enabled tokens.
resource "netbox_secret_backend_role" "ipam_writer" {
  backend         = netbox_secret_backend.netbox.path
  name            = "ipam-writer"
  netbox_username = "svc-ipam"
  write_enabled   = true
  ttl             = 1800
  max_ttl         = 14400
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `backend` (String) Mount path of the NetBox secrets engine.
- `name` (String) Name of the role.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Description applied to each minted NetBox token.
- `max_ttl` (Number) Maximum lease TTL in seconds for tokens minted from this role.
- `netbox_user_id` (Number) Id of the NetBox service user tokens are minted for. Set this or netbox_username. Computed when resolved from netbox_username.
- `netbox_username` (String) Username of the NetBox service user, resolved to an id at write time. Alternative to netbox_user_id.
- `ttl` (Number) Default lease TTL in seconds for tokens minted from this role (the minted token's NetBox expiry is aligned to the lease).
- `write_enabled` (Boolean) Whether minted tokens permit create/update/delete (default false: read-only).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by <backend>/roles/<name>.
terraform import netbox_secret_backend_role.inventory_reader netbox/roles/inventory-reader
```
